title: City of 11,000 structures found in Ecuadorian jungle

tellings.quote: They they found a city I think with 11,000 structures

plain: Somewhere in the Ecuadorian Amazon, researchers are said to have found a lost city of about 11,000 structures. A researcher named Luke Caverns says so on the show, hedging with "I think" and not saying who found it or when. If true, the jungle would have hidden a large, forgotten civilisation.
